svg.text: OPTIONAL DESCRIPTION DOES NOT CHANGE THE GRIP ANCHOR.
SCALE 1:1 · DEFAULT BOUNDS · EMPTY OR SHORT VALUE
NATURAL HEIGHT IS MEASURED IN A HIDDEN MIRROR.
H = CLAMP(H1, NATURAL, H2); CSS MIN / MAX ALSO APPLY.
GRIP SITS BOTTOM-RIGHT; AUTO-GROW HIDES IT.
WIDTH FOLLOWS PARENT; DEMO CAPS AT W0.
ROW LIMITS CLAMP TO 1–100; M ≥ N.
SUPPORTING SLOT IS OPTIONAL AND WRAPS.
LABEL / ERROR PLACEMENT BELONGS TO CALLER.
PLAIN HAS NO BORDER OR FOCUS SHADOW.
PADDING AND CORNER RADIUS ARE RETAINED.
REST: NO SHADOW. FOCUS: SOLID SPREAD.
ACCENT / INVALID USE THE SAME 3 PX ENVELOPE.
SCHEMATIC · SEMANTIC LAYERS · Z SPACING NOT DIMENSIONED
Z GAPS EXPLAIN PAINT ORDER; THEY ARE NOT CSS DEPTH.
MIRROR IS OFFSCREEN AND NOT A VISIBLE LAYER.
SCALE 4:1 · SHARED CENTER · NO INNER WELL
CONTENT INSET: B + S1 / B + S2.
PLAIN RETAINS R1 BUT DRAWS NO FRAME.
Baseline measured in browser after fonts were ready.
All variants / modes / state branches reviewed.
